```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(cluster)
library(factoextra)
```
#loading data to perform comparison
```{r}
cereals <- read.csv("Cereals.csv")
cereals_clean <- na.omit(cereals)
#remove rows with missing data, keeping only numeric columns
num_vars <- cereals_clean %>% select(where(is.numeric))
num_scaled <- scale(num_vars)
#scaling the data
dist_matrix <- dist(num_scaled, method = "euclidean")
```
```{r}
hc_single <- hclust(dist_matrix, method = "single")
fviz_dend(hc_single, main = "Single Linkage")
hc_complete <- hclust(dist_matrix, method = "complete")
fviz_dend(hc_complete, main = "Complete Linkage")
hc_average <- hclust(dist_matrix, method = "average")
fviz_dend(hc_average, main = "Average Linkage")
hc_ward <- hclust(dist_matrix, method = "ward.D2")
fviz_dend(hc_ward, main = "Ward's Method")
```
# I would chose the Ward method

```{r}
# comparision values for the HC clusters
coph_single   <- cor(dist_matrix, cophenetic(hc_single))
coph_complete <- cor(dist_matrix, cophenetic(hc_complete))
coph_average  <- cor(dist_matrix, cophenetic(hc_average))
coph_ward     <- cor(dist_matrix, cophenetic(hc_ward))
```

#testing K values
```{r}
for (k in 3:6) {
     cat("k =", k, "\n")
     print(fviz_silhouette(silhouette(cutree(hc_ward, k), dist_matrix)))
}
```
# I would chose 3 clusters for the data.
```{r}
clusters <- cutree(hc_ward, k = 4)   # example
table(clusters)

set.seed(123)
n <- nrow(num_scaled)
index <- sample(1:n, n/2)
# creating partitions
A <- num_scaled[index, ]
B <- num_scaled[-index, ]

#cluster A
dist_A <- dist(A)
hc_A <- hclust(dist_A, method = "ward.D2")
clusters_A <- cutree(hc_A, k = 4)
```
```{r}
centroids <- aggregate(A, by = list(cluster = clusters_A), FUN = mean)
centroids <- centroids[,-1]
```

```{r}
 assign_B <- apply(B, 1, function(x) {
   dists <- apply(centroids, 1, function(c) sum((x - c)^2))
   which.min(dists)
 })
```


# Compare to full-data clustering
```{r}
full_clusters <- cutree(hc_ward, k = 4)
B_full <- full_clusters[-index]

table(assign_B, B_full)

```
 # healthy cereals cluster analysis
```{r}
health_vars <- cereals_clean %>% 
  select(calories, protein, fat, sugars, fiber, rating)

dist_health <- dist(health_vars, method = "euclidean")
hc_health <- hclust(dist_health, method = "ward.D2")
fviz_dend(hc_health, main = "Healthy Cereals Clustering")
```
